explication: Potree is a browser-based WebGL viewer for massive point clouds. The principal workflow is: a user opens a project or point-cloud source; loaders read Potree, EPT, LAS/LAZ, and related formats; workers decode point attributes; octree geometry supplies visible data; the viewer renders it with configurable materials. Users then navigate, measure, profile, clip, annotate, animate cameras, export results, or optionally integrate Cesium and WebXR. The tree and excerpts show runtime boundaries, but not all viewer orchestration calls.
